name: std::extents<IndexType,Extents...>::rev-prod-of-extents
intro: Returns the product of the sizes of extents with index greater than i. The behavior is undefined if i < rank() is false.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
i

 -

 an index above which the sizes of corresponding extents will be multiplied together

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: If i + 1 < rank() is true, return the product of extent(k) for all k in range [i + 1, rank()), otherwise 1.

summary: Returns the product of the sizes of extents with index greater than i. The behavior is undefined if i < rank() is false.
